The '''Guuko Pure Light party''' was an organization that once carried out genocide on the [[Guukosi]] during an invasion. Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] afterward, an upper-class diner used a symbol that was very similar the Pure Light party symbol, a winged circle. However, only the older Guukosi recognized the symbol as that of the Pure Light party.
